input_messages.content: Hi there. My phone has been saying "No Service" for the past few hours, and I’m not sure what to do. I mostly use it for calls and texts, so I’m a bit worried. Can you help me get it working again?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that helps. What should I do next?
I’ve just completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do now to get my service back?
Oh, I get a bit nervous about restarting my phone—will I lose any of my photos or messages if I do that? I really don’t want to lose anything important. Can you reassure me before I try?
I restarted my phone like you said, but it still shows "No Signal" at the top. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated.
At the top of my phone, I see a "No Signal" icon, and it also says "Data Disabled." The battery is at 80%. There’s no airplane symbol or anything else unusual. What should I do next?
It looks like my phone says there’s no SIM card detected. What does that mean? Is there something wrong with my phone?

I took out the SIM card and put it back in, and now the top of my phone shows full signal bars, 5G, and it says "Data Enabled." I think it’s working again! Thank you so much for your help—I was really worried there for a bit.
Thank you for your patience and for guiding me through everything. I really appreciate your help! Have a wonderful day. ###STOP###

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

- After reinserting the SIM card, restart your phone.
